Saiba como se inscrever – Para participar do processo seletivo, é necessário preencher o formulário de inscrição on-line e efetuar o pagamento do boleto bancário no valor de R$ 120 até o dia 26 de maio. A isenção da taxa de inscrição pode ser solicitada até dia 30 de abril por candidatos inscritos no Cadastro Único para Programas do Governo Federal (CadÚnico) e por doadores de medula óssea cadastrados em entidades reconhecidas pelo Ministério da Saúde. No ato da inscrição, os candidatos devem ficar atentos à escolha do cargo pretendido. As provas objetivas serão aplicadas no dia 8 de junho, com caráter eliminatório e classificatório, compostas por 60 questões de múltipla escolha nas áreas de língua portuguesa, língua inglesa, legislação, raciocínio lógico e conhecimentos específicos. We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.
